offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures IV infusion supplies, infusion pumps and software, and devices for vascular access and critical care. It sells to hospitals, outpatient clinics, and home infusion providers through direct sales and medical supply distributors.

primary_products.value: IV administration sets and needle-free connectors; infusion pumps and software; closed-system drug transfer devices; vascular access catheters; airway and temperature management devices

primary_services.value: Infusion pump maintenance and repair; infusion system implementation and integration

customer_segment.value: B2B: Hospitals, health systems, outpatient infusion clinics, oncology pharmacies, and home infusion providers; B2G: Public hospitals and government healthcare systems

end_markets.value: Acute hospital care; outpatient and home infusion; oncology; anesthesia and surgery; critical care

revenue_model.value: product sales: Infusion disposables, pumps, vascular access devices, and critical care equipment; service fees: Infusion pump maintenance and repair

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns purchased materials and components into infusion supplies, pumps, and critical care devices for healthcare providers; software / platform: Connects infusion pumps with hospital medication and patient record systems; service provider: Installs and maintains infusion equipment for hospitals and other healthcare providers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: Infusion consumables, pump systems and software, vascular access, and airway and temperature management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Company sales teams serving hospitals and health systems; distributors / dealers: Medical supply distributors serving hospitals, clinics, and home infusion providers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Medical devices subject to FDA clearance and quality requirements, and to EU medical device conformity rules

notes: The current scope of separately billed infusion system integration services is uncertain.
